backgrounds.club: A small cozy Japanese public high school literature club room: worn wooden central table, six mismatched chairs, full bookshelves, stacked handmade literary magazines and stationery, windows toward quiet school courtyard, warm after-school light. Not a library hall.
backgrounds.track: A Japanese public high school athletics ground in Toyohashi: reddish running track with lane markings, field, school buildings, distant low green hills, equipment shed and bench, clear warm afternoon, eye level from track edge.
backgrounds.cafe: Interior of an ordinary affordable Japanese family restaurant in Toyohashi. Cozy booth beside wide window, dark upholstered seats facing one another, wooden tabletop with two water glasses and a small plain receipt, drink bar in distance, soft afternoon sunlight. View across the booth, good space to overlay a standing character.
backgrounds.bookstore: Interior of a large established local bookstore in Toyohashi, inspired by Seibunkan. Neat wooden shelves of colorful unlettered book spines, literature and light novel aisles, small stationery display, street windows, cozy realistic commercial space, afternoon light. No invented readable signs.
backgrounds.station: Toyohashi railway station east-side pedestrian plaza atmosphere, Aichi Japan. Modern understated station entrance and covered pedestrian deck, city tram infrastructure visible at street level, benches and planters, blue sky with late afternoon light. Faithful everyday Japanese midsized city scale, no fantasy buildings, no readable signs.
backgrounds.park: A peaceful garden path in Toyohashi's Non Hoi zoological and botanical park, Aichi Japan. Leafy trees, flower beds, quiet wooden benches, a glass conservatory in middle distance, early-summer daylight, landscaped park setting rather than wilderness. Eye-level path perspective.
backgrounds.council: An ordinary Japanese high school student council room. Long meeting table with tidy paperwork and folders, several chairs, office cabinets, a wall bulletin board with indistinct blank notes, small desktop computer at side, large windows, calm late-afternoon sun. Human modest scale, not a corporate boardroom.
backgrounds.home: A warm modest contemporary Japanese family home dining and living room in Toyohashi at early evening. Wooden dining table with two chairs visible, home kitchen beyond, a neatly placed school bag, a mug, curtains and amber ceiling light, lived-in but tidy. Inviting sibling family household, no luxury mansion.

events.201: An emotional still-life in an ordinary Japanese family restaurant booth, two half-empty water glasses, a crumpled straw wrapper, an unpaid receipt with no readable writing, a closed paperback and small wallet on wood table, empty seat across the table, warm late afternoon window light. Capture the awkward aftermath of a schoolgirl's heartbreak and a classmate staying to listen. No people.
events.202: A Japanese high school athletics track edge seen close from a shaded bench. Running shoes, a sports bottle with condensation, folded practice schedule and a stopwatch turned face down on the bench. Track stretches into warm afternoon distance. Quiet pause after exhausting training, friendship through waiting, no people.
events.203: Close atmospheric composition in a Japanese literature club room: several hand-written manuscript pages without legible text, red proofreading pencil, two mugs and a simple bookmark on a worn wooden shared table; full bookshelves and two empty chairs behind. Warm window light and an unfinished story left open between friends. No people.
events.204: Close atmospheric still life in a Japanese high school student council room: neatly organized application forms without readable text, navy folders, capped pen, two chairs on either side of a meeting table, soft sunset light through windows. A completed day's work gives way to a personal conversation. No people.
events.205: Cozy Japanese family dining table in evening, two cups of tea, several high school brochures with indistinct non-readable designs, a pencil marking a blank calendar, warm home kitchen behind. A brother supporting his younger sister's school plans, family affection conveyed by objects only. No people.
events.206: A Japanese train station sheltered entrance on a rainy evening in Toyohashi. One folded dark umbrella and a small paper takeaway cup near a bench, raindrops on clear canopy, wet pavement reflecting station lights, road crossing beyond. Two friends waiting for the rain to ease, no people.
